description: Unit test class for ThingLiveCommandAckRequestSetter, verifying immutability, handling of null commands, header modifications concerning acknowledgement labels, and default behaviors.

classes.name: ThingLiveCommandAckRequestSetterTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for verifying the behavior of ThingLiveCommandAckRequestSetter.

methods.name: assertImmutability
methods.description: Checks that the ThingLiveCommandAckRequestSetter class is immutable.

methods.name: tryToApplyNullCommand
methods.description: Ensures that applying null to the setter throws a NullPointerException with the appropriate message.

methods.name: removeLiveResponseAckLabelIfNoResponseRequired
methods.description: Tests that the acknowledgement request is removed when response is not required.

methods.name: addLiveResponseAckLabelByDefault
methods.description: Verifies that a default LIVE_RESPONSE acknowledgement label is added if none is present.

methods.name: filterOutOtherBuiltInDittoAcknowledgementLabels
methods.description: Checks that only the LIVE_RESPONSE acknowledgement label remains after filtering.

methods.name: addsLiveResponseAckLabelToAlreadyRequiredAckLabels
methods.description: Ensures the LIVE_RESPONSE label is added if acknowledgement requests are already marked as required.

methods.name: notAddingLiveResponseAckLabelToExplicitlyEmptyRequiredAckLabels
methods.description: Verifies that no acknowledgement labels are added if acknowledgementRequests is explicitly empty and responseRequired is true.
